list.title: Dynamic Multi-Byte Prediction With Hierarchical Language Models

extra.desc: Multi-byte prediction accelerates byte-level hierarchical language models by generating parallel bytes via variable-length windows and causal attention masking, improving inference speed with minimal quality loss.

list.title: HarmProfile: Characterizing Harmful Distributions in Frontier LLMs

extra.desc: HarmProfile is a benchmark dataset that characterizes frontier LLM safety failures through content analysis, revealing that harmfulness and diversity increase with model capability.

list.title: Accuracy and Order Sensitivity Diverge Under Label-Free Strategies

extra.desc: Preventing models from seeing option labels during answering does not reliably reduce positional bias or improve multiple-choice accuracy, and only showing all options with an LLM matcher preserves baseline performance.

list.title: Beyond Visual CoT: Internalized Visual Thinking for Proactive Video Reasoning

extra.desc: Internalized Visual Thinking trains multimodal models to predict future frame embeddings during post-training, enabling direct answer generation at inference without synthesizing intermediate images and cutting latency over fivefold.

list.title: StateM: Reaching 95.3% Raw Accuracy, or a \$15 Frontier Run, on Terminal-Bench 2.1 via Harness Scaling

extra.desc: StateM is a runtime system that improves long-horizon agent execution through durable states, recoverable runbooks, and enforceable procedural controls without altering model weights.

list.title: StreamOPD: A Post-Training Recipe with Spatio-Temporal Cue Gating for Streaming Video Understanding

extra.desc: StreamOPD improves streaming video understanding via on-policy distillation with verifiable rewards and a spatio-temporal cue-gating mechanism, achieving near-teacher performance without inference-time memory.

list.title: Valid Per-Field Selective Risk Control for Document Extraction: Three Failure Modes, a Validity Ladder, and When Conditioning Pays

extra.desc: Per-field selective risk control for document extraction requires a validity ladder with fit/val splits and Mondrian PAC certificates, revealing that support-bin provenance outperforms learned fusion only under specific model conditions.

list.title: Plausible but Not Valid: A Psychometric Audit of LLMs as Synthetic Survey Respondents

extra.desc: Large language models replicate broad psychometric trends in synthetic survey responses but fail to match human joint distributions, reliability, and mediation structures, making them unsuitable replacements for real respondents.

list.title: Advancing Open and Reproducible Relational Learning: RelArena-α, TabPFN-Rel and RPI

extra.desc: Prior Labs released open-source tools including a unified relational benchmark framework, a TabPFN-based relational model, and a model-agnostic predictive interface to advance reproducible relational learning.

list.title: GRNEdit: Efficient General Video Editing from a New Binary-Evidence Perspective in Generative Refinement Networks

extra.desc: GRNEdit is a lightweight two-stage framework that models video editing intent via binary semantic decisions and source evidence, achieving strong results with minimal parameters.

list.title: MOSS-VL Technical Report

extra.desc: MOSS-VL is an open vision-language model family enabling real-time interaction by attending to vision via gated cross-attention during generation, using a synthesized interaction corpus and staged curriculum to achieve strong streaming performance with reduced time-to-first-token latency.

list.title: A Plug-and-Play 2D Motion Interface for Real-World Motion Language Models

extra.desc: A plug-and-play 2D motion interface allows pretrained motion language models to process 2D inputs without retraining, improving real-world applicability.

list.title: How Do Agents Fail on AutoResearch: End-to-End Diagnostic Evaluation on 100 Real-World Frontier Research Tasks

extra.desc: Autonomous research agents evaluated across the full scientific lifecycle reveal a pervasive lack of metacognitive self-correction, motivating a new benchmark and failure taxonomy.

list.title: Large Discovery Models: Empirically-grounded Model-Based Open-Ended Search

extra.desc: A recurrent Large Discovery Model couples generative proposal with a Bayesian non-parametric reward surrogate to guide uncertainty-aware search across molecules, proteins, and programs.

list.title: TRACE-Bench: Decomposing and Diagnosing Multi-Reference Image Generation

extra.desc: This work proposes a compositional operator framework and TRACE-Bench to diagnose multi-reference image generation capabilities across atomic operations.

list.title: WorldRover: A Scalable Synthetic Video Data Engine for World Exploration with Rich Annotations

extra.desc: WorldRover is a synthetic data engine that generates long-range, richly annotated video sequences with depth, camera motion, and tracking signals to support training models for coherent world exploration.

list.title: Prototype-Rectified Iterative Self-supervised Manifold Denoising under Severe Acoustic Shift

extra.desc: PRISM is a fast, training-free test-time adaptation method that reverses low-rank affine noise distortions in audio-text models using frozen text prototypes and geometric corrections.

list.title: Learn What's Left, Not What's Mastered: Saturation Aware Advantage Reweighting for Multi-Reward Policy Optimization

extra.desc: SA-MRPO independently standardizes multi-objective rewards and adaptively discounts saturated objectives to redirect optimization toward under-optimized goals.

list.title: DumpsterCluster: From Dumpster Diving to Serving LLaMA-70B on $60 GPUs

extra.desc: Retired GPUs can form low-cost clusters for LLM inference, but their economic and environmental viability depends heavily on local electricity prices and carbon intensity.

list.title: HiFi-BRep: High-Fidelity Latent Representation for Robust B-Rep Generation

extra.desc: HiFi-BRep improves B-Rep synthesis by using a topology-aware encoder and a single-stage decoder that jointly predicts geometry and topology with differentiable validity constraints.

list.title: Drive, Pack, Fly: The Travelling Thief Problem with Drone

extra.desc: The Travelling Thief Problem with Drone jointly optimizes ground routing, drone synchronization, and item selection to maximize profit, using mixed-integer programming, metaheuristics, and attention-based deep reinforcement learning with a hybrid refinement approach.

list.title: AnyTalk: Speech Animation for Arbitrary Characters Leveraging a Video Generation Model

extra.desc: AnyTalk generates 3D speech animations for arbitrary characters without animation data by adapting video diffusion models via character-specific fine-tuning and optimizing blendshape parameters from synthesized talking-head videos, with a distilled real-time variant.

list.title: Prior Audit-Repair Context Shifts LLM Verifier Thresholds Toward Leniency

extra.desc: Prior audit and repair episodes in context reduce false alarms by shifting decision thresholds rather than discrimination, with repair content and audit verdict complementarily affecting different model families.

list.title: Gathered, Not Admitted: How Attention Brings a Latent Variable into Verbalizable Form

extra.desc: In language models, flexible reuse demands attention-mediated gathering at a mid-depth window to make latent variables readable, without a selective gate, and readout measures poorly reflect actual use.

list.title: HarnessEval-W: Agentifying the Evaluation of Visual Worlds

extra.desc: HarnessEval-W uses hierarchical sub-agents to decompose world-model evaluations into verifiable reasoning chains that justify scores with transparent evidence.

list.title: An Empirical Study of Training Pixel-Space Text-to-Image Diffusion Models

extra.desc: Researchers propose a latent-to-pixel training strategy that accelerates convergence and improves inference speed for large-scale pixel-space diffusion models.

list.title: Improving the matrix multiplication exponent with modern optimization and AlphaEvolve

extra.desc: Refinements to combination loss analysis via reformulated optimization, machine learning-based algorithms, and AlphaEvolve yield an improved upper bound on the matrix multiplication exponent.

list.title: PACE-Bench: Benchmarking Physics Adaptation via Code Evolution in Dynamic Environments

extra.desc: PACE-Bench evaluates self-evolving agents on physics adaptation tasks requiring iterative code redesign after environmental mutations, revealing that simulator-grounded reflection outperforms unverified self-revision but mechanism redesign remains a major bottleneck.

list.title: VideoGAIA: A Benchmark for General AI Assistants on Agentic Video Understanding

extra.desc: VideoGAIA introduces a multi-turn, tool-augmented benchmark that evaluates agentic video understanding for advanced multimodal models through complex real-world tasks.

list.title: UI-Mate: Advancing Open-Weight Foundation GUI Agents with In-Context Demonstrations

extra.desc: UI-Mate is a foundation GUI agent that uses environment-grounded training and in-context demonstration learning to improve reliability on long-horizon office tasks, achieving state-of-the-art results on computer-use benchmarks.

list.title: Position: AI Agents in Scientific Teams Should Be Studied as Human-Agent Systems

extra.desc: Scientific collaboration with AI agents requires studying human-agent pairs to avoid risks like reduced inquiry diversity and to foster synergistic discovery.

list.title: When Context Bites: Detecting RAG Poisoning via Document-Level Attention Collapse

extra.desc: D-SCAN detects retrieval poisoning by monitoring attention collapse dynamics in language model generations.

list.title: ConceptFormer: Learning Adaptive Latent Concepts for Query-Document Alignment in Visual Document Retrieval

extra.desc: ConceptFormer learns continuous latent concept representations to bridge visual evidence and semantic relevance for visual document retrieval without relying on text intermediates or raw visual annotations.

list.title: Ventor-QTest: Threat-Model-Driven Verification of Vendor-Hosted LLM APIs

extra.desc: Ventor-QTest audits hosted open-weight model APIs via repeated and long-sequence black-box probes, measuring average and extreme fidelity loss to detect degradation in long-horizon agentic performance.

list.title: ENTLORE: A Graph-Grounded Benchmark for Latent Organizational Reasoning in Enterprise Question Answering

extra.desc: ENTLORE is a benchmark framework that evaluates enterprise question answering by requiring recovery of implicit organizational relations across routine documents, revealing that even with gold sources many latent reasoning questions remain unanswered.

list.title: ClawGym II: Exploring Black-Box RL on Agent Harness

extra.desc: A unified black-box reinforcement learning framework enables stable, scalable optimization of general agents through complex harnesses via sandbox execution, trajectory reconstruction, and mix-harness training.

list.title: R^3-Bench: LLMs Struggle with Resource-Rational Reasoning under Shared Budgets

extra.desc: R³-Bench reveals that shared computation budgets cause reasoning agents to underperform relative to their single-problem capabilities across math, coding, and abstract reasoning tasks.

list.title: GenRouter: Unified Workflow Routing for Agentic Image Generation

extra.desc: GenRouter is a unified routing framework that adaptively directs prompts to optimal agentic image-generation workflows, cutting costs and latency while improving visual alignment and enabling continuous self-evolution.

list.title: VibeWorlding: Can Multimodal Agents Construct 3D Open Worlds End-to-End?

extra.desc: A unified framework benchmarks and trains multimodal agents that infer intent, plan 3D scenes, invoke tools, and reflect on feedback, revealing that reinforcement learning improves open-source models beyond closed-source frontiers.

list.title: Understanding Cognition-Induced Risks in Agentic AI Systems

extra.desc: Agentic systems built on large language models pose escalating risks to human agency and autonomy across physical, social, and self-referential cognitive levels, requiring targeted mitigation strategies.

list.title: MegaParts: Scaling Part-Aware 3D Object Generation to 300 Parts via Token-Efficient Autoregressive Modeling

extra.desc: MegaParts scales part-aware 3D generation via token-efficient vector-quantized part tokens and structured autoregressive sequence modeling with long-context training.

list.title: Agentic Transaction: Towards ACID-Compliant Agent Systems

extra.desc: An ACID-compliant framework for agentic transactions introduces semantic guarantees to ensure reliable, isolated, and durable execution of long-horizon LLM agent workflows.

list.title: NaviDC-OCR: Navigating Document Parsing Across Digital and Camera-Captured Documents

extra.desc: NaviDC-OCR is a unified vision-language framework that integrates deformation-aware learning, adaptive layout sampling, and decoupled content-structure training to improve document parsing accuracy and structural reasoning.

list.title: Is this Citation on Point?

extra.desc: Large language models reliably detect incorrect case citations but frequently miss wrong pinpoint page references, conflating topical relevance with precise legal support.

list.title: Nanbeige4.2-3B on Apple Silicon: Fixing Deployment Bugs and Decreasing Looped Transformer Memory Overhead

extra.desc: A 3B-parameter agentic model using a Looped Transformer requires bug fixes and a chunked-prefill strategy to run reliably on Apple Silicon and complete agentic tasks.

list.title: Amplified Does Not Mean Predictive: Reasoning Behaviors in Thinking Models

extra.desc: Reasoning training amplifies deliberative behaviors like self-correction more than high-correctness behaviors such as confidence calibration, revealing a gap between amplified and correctness-linked reasoning patterns.

list.title: Modular Cognitive Architecture Emerges in Large Language Models

extra.desc: Large language models develop modular neural architectures that mirror human brain specialization across language, reasoning, and physical cognition, suggesting modularity is a fundamental property of intelligent systems.

list.title: Apodex Discovery: Reality Benchmarks and Environments for Evaluating and Building Discoverative Artificial Intelligence

extra.desc: Apodex Discovery introduces a framework for verifiable, extended AI investigations using a heavy-duty solver and structured evaluation across real-world scientific tasks.

list.title: Who Speaks Matters: Authority-Aware Multi-View RAG over Italian Parliamentary Proceedings

extra.desc: ParliamentRAG is a retrieval-augmented generation system for Italian parliamentary records that uses topic-dependent speaker authority to retrieve expert perspectives and generate faithful, multi-perspective summaries.

list.title: DFM Mimir v1: An Open HRM Delivering Frontier Performance at 1B Parameters Using Only Permissible Post-Training Data

extra.desc: Mimir v1 is a 1-billion-parameter Hierarchical Reasoning Model trained solely on permissible data that achieves competitive English results and state-of-the-art Danish performance across multiple benchmarks.
